name: codemed-hub
description: Codemed Hub — CRM + OS Digital + WhatsApp Nativo + Dashboard IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && npx tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
